sources.entry: Flarum - Delightfully simple forums. Flarum is the next-generation forum software that makes online discussion fun again. (Source Code) MIT PHP

summary.one_liner: Flarum is a self-hostable, PHP-based discussion forum software that aims to be fast, simple, and extensible.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Flarum as a discussion platform for websites that is built with PHP and uses the Mithril JavaScript framework for its interface. It is positioned as lightweight, with no clutter or complex dependencies, and designed to be consistent and responsive across platforms out of the box. It offers an Extension API for customizing, extending, and integrating the forum. This repository is the Flarum skeleton application; most core development happens in flarum/core. The README points to an installation guide, documentation, a community forum, and Discord for support.
use_cases: add a discussion board to a website
build a customized community with extensions
how_to_run: Read the Installation guide referenced in the README (not included in the README text)
notable: Lightweight PHP build with no heavy dependencies, per the README
Extension API for customization and integration
Repository is the skeleton app; core development lives in flarum/core
caveats: The README does not include detailed installation steps; it refers to an external installation guide
Repository itself is a skeleton app; most development happens in flarum/core
